dedup_rationale: dedup unit is the event group (same selection_group_id the budget and summary use), never a bare text hash; no global SHA-based removal of originals
one record per narrative unit, richest enrichment wins (score, then table row), so identical candidates on the same unit cannot destabilize selection
inside a group only identical (normalized text, source role) copies collapse and the table row view wins; the group keeps at least one member and is never split

across groups a group is dropped only when its whole signature is equal to or contained in a surviving group's signature, so every surviving sentence still exists once and no unique content is lost (asserted by the integration test)
partial overlaps are conservatively kept: similar sentences that differ in project, period, company, role or negation normalize differently and are never merged
question and company-answer candidates never share one selection_group_id
selection_rationale: hard cap 96/160 unchanged; a bundle costs exactly its span count and is selected whole or not at all
reserved reasons (downstream_center_certification_timeline, downstream_business_extension) are still placed first, and one proposal per page per round keeps cross-page coverage

soft per-category fair share ceil(limit / active categories) counted in spans: a category that reaches its share is ranked behind categories still under share, so high-frequency generic risk/commitment language cannot crowd out product validation, capacity/fundraising and industry demand; the quota never removes an item, so budget still fills when other categories run out
the quota only engages when limit >= 2 x active categories, so tight budgets keep the historical priority order plus page rotation

oversized groups (cost > limit) are dropped whole and reported as group_exceeds_limit; otherwise budget_full; ordering ties resolve to category order, priority, larger bundle, bundle key, then numeric page order, so input order and equal scores cannot change the result
planner reads only the items passed in: no disk, no model, no network (asserted by tests that fail on builtins.open)
